lesson: Fixed-radius compactness plus moving-scale normalized kinetic-energy smallness cannot control a moving-ball quantity without scale-aligned tightness: mass may escape into an annulus invisible to every fixed compact. Under fixed-ball strong L2 convergence, the exact repair is lim_R->infinity limsup_k integral_{B(a_k) minus B(R)} |v_k-v|^2 = 0.

framework_feedback.proposal: Before transferring compactness or local convergence to a moving-scale QoI, require a scale-aligned tightness witness or run an explicit tail-modulus falsifier.

scope: not a Navier-Stokes or Euler solution family
